description: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, BIMI and MTA-STS for one domain in one call, each judged pass, weak, fail or not set, with the essentials separated from the optional records. BIMI and MTA-STS are optional and come back "absent", never failed. Use it when someone has been told to "fix their email authentication" and does not know which record that means.
name: check_email_authentication
title: Email authentication, all six records
